model: Primo (single-phase) / Symo GEN24 (three-phase hybrid) — SunSpec Int+SF inverter model 103
source: Fronius implements the open SunSpec Modbus map. Inverter models 101 (1ph) / 103 (3ph), 'Int+SF' variant. Function 0x03 (holding). Enable Modbus TCP in Fronius Solar.web / device config; default port 502, unit id 1.
baseNote: Addresses below are the common Fronius layout where the inverter model block begins at register 40070 (1-based) → the points sit at 40072+. If your unit uses a different SunSpec base (some firmwares start at 40000 / 50000, or expose the 'float' models 111/113 instead of 103), run scripts/sunspec-discover.js to print the real model base and adjust block.start + addresses, OR switch to registers.generic.sunspec.json offsets. The DECODER and driver are correct regardless — only these absolute addresses are firmware-dependent.
